candidates.name: Search for triangulation stations
verified_facts: OS states OSGB36 National Grid is now defined through ETRS89 coordinates and OSTN15.
Archive triangulation coordinates were not realised through ETRS89/OSTN15 and can no longer be considered true current OSGB36 National Grid coordinates of those stations.
Expected agreement between ETRS89/OSTN15-derived coordinates and archive triangulation coordinates is about 0.10m RMS down to third order.
semantic_limits: Legacy triangulation coordinates are archive context and must not be used as high-accuracy current parcel control.

candidates.name: OS legacy control data
verified_facts: OS groups passive stations, benchmarks and triangulation stations as legacy control data.
The legacy datasets are no longer maintained and are exposed through archive search tools.
OS separates legacy control from current geodetic and positioning services.
semantic_limits: An archived mark or coordinate must not override current OS Net/OSTN15/OSGM15 lineage without a specific verified modern tie.
